type Expr = Num int | Add Expr Expr | Mul Expr Expr | Neg Expr
let evaluate e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evaluate a + evaluate b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evaluate a * evaluate b
    case Neg a: -(evaluate a)
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e
let terms = [(Mul (Add (Num 1) (Neg (Num 0))) (Add (Num 0) (Num (-1)))), (Neg (Num 0))]
terms |> List.map simplify |> List.map render |> List.iter print
print (List.map evaluate terms)

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let evaluate e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evaluate a + evaluate b
    case Mul a b: evaluate a * evaluate b
    case Neg a: -(evaluate a)
let show e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{show a}"
let shrink e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e
let exprs = [(Add (Num 0) (Num 5)), (Neg (Add (Add (Num 1) (Num 7)) (Mul (Num 5) (Num (-1))))), (Add (Num 1) (Add (Num 1) (Add (Num 0) (Num 4))))]

type Term = Num int | Add Term Term | Mul Term Term | Neg Term
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
let show e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"

  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b

    case Neg a: -(calc a)

  match e:

    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

let decodeLine line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }
let inputs = ["cy=x", "kit=66", "bo=x", "ray=6=1", "ned=9=1"]

  case None: print "none parsed"
let sumAll xs =

let collatz n acc =
  if n == 1 then acc
  else if n % 2 == 0 then collatz (n // 2) (acc + 1)
  else collatz (3 * n + 1) (acc + 1)

type Expr = Num int | Add Expr Expr | Mul Expr Expr | Neg Expr | Var string
let vars = Map.ofList [("x", 5), ("y", -3)]
let evaluate e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evaluate a + evaluate b
    case Mul a b: evaluate a * evaluate b
    case Neg a: -(evaluate a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars
let show e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{show a}"
    case Var v: v
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

    case Node _ _ _: t

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let calc e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b
    case Neg a: -(calc a)
let show e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{show a}"
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e
let exprs = [(Neg (Add (Num 0) (Num 1))), (Add (Mul (Add (Num 1) (Num 3)) (Add (Num 0) (Num 3))) (Neg (Num 7))), (Add (Num 1) (Add (Add (Num 7) (Num (-1))) (Add (Num 7) (Num 4))))]
exprs |> List.map simplify |> List.map show |> List.iter print

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }

let combine xs =
  List.fold (fun acc r ->
    result {
      let! total = acc
      let! (_, n) = r
      return total + n
    }) (Ok 0) xs

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [49, 36, 3, 29, 19, 28, 33, 50, 45] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT tree)
let depthOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)
print (depthOf tree)
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT tree)

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
let exprs = [(Add (Neg (Add (Num 1) (Num 3))) (Neg (Neg (Num (-2))))), (Num 9)]

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }
let inputs = ["eli", "oz=18", "quin=x", "pam=2=1", "gus", "sue=8=1"]
let results = List.map parseEntry inputs

let errs = results |> List.filter Result.isError |> List.len

  case None: print "none parsed"
let combine xs =

      let! (_, n) = r
      return total + n

type Token =
  | Turn int
  | Skip int string
  | Jump int
  | Halt int string
  | Store
let describe t =
  match t:
    case Turn n0: f"turn({n0})"
    case Skip n0 s1: f"skip({n0},{s1})"
    case Jump n0 if n0 % 2 == 0: f"jump!({n0})"
    case Jump n0: f"jump({n0})"
    case Halt n0 s1 if n0 > 3: f"halt!({n0},{s1})"
    case Halt n0 s1: f"halt({n0},{s1})"
    case Store: f"store"
let cost t =
  match t:
    case Store: 3
    case Turn x0: x0 * 4
    case Jump x0: x0 * 4
    case Halt x0 _: x0
    case _: 2
let stream = [Jump (-3), (Turn 3), Halt 8 "oz", (Skip 10 "ray")]
print (String.join " " (List.map describe stream))
let grandSum = stream |> List.sumBy cost
print f"grandSum={grandSum}"
print (List.sort stream)

type Token = Load int | Push int | Skip string int | Jump int int
let describe t =
  match t:
    case Load n0: f"load({n0})"
    case Push 1: "push-1"
    case Push n0: f"push({n0})"
    case Skip s0 n1: f"skip({s0},{n1})"
    case Jump 0 _: "jump-0"
    case Jump n0 n1: f"jump({n0},{n1})"
let cost t =
  match t:
    case Skip _ x1: x1
    case Jump x0 x1: x0 + x1
    case _: 0

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [16, 32, 33, 7, 24, 56] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let minT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)

type Term = Num int | Add Term Term | Mul Term Term | Neg Term
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)

  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({show a} + {show b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{show a} * {show b}"

  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [50, 22, 26, 19, 3] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt
print (sumOf tree)
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsOf k tree) [50, 4, 1])
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT tree)

let readPair line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }

let evaluate e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evaluate a + evaluate b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evaluate a * evaluate b
    case Neg a: -(evaluate a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 env
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
    case Var v: v
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

type Msg =
  | Rest int
  | Halt
  | Mark
  | Store int string
let explain t =
  match t:
    case Rest n0 if n0 > 9: f"rest!({n0})"
    case Rest n0: f"rest({n0})"
    case Store n0 s1 if 0 <= n0 < 11: f"store!({n0},{s1})"
    case Store n0 s1: f"store({n0},{s1})"
    case Halt | Mark: "halt/mark"
let score t =
  match t:
    case Rest x0: x0 * 3
    case Halt: 5
    case Mark: 8
    case _: 0

let readPair line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    return (k, n)
  }
let inputs = ["ray = 2", "dee=2", "bo=73", "hal=x"]
let results = List.map readPair inputs
List.iter print results
let errs = results |> List.filter Result.isError |> List.len
print f"{errs} errors"
let sumAll xs =
  List.fold (fun acc r ->
    result {
      let! total = acc
      let! (_, n) = r
      return total + n
    }) (Ok 0) xs
print (sumAll results |> Result.mapError String.upper)

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = List.fold (fun acc x -> add x acc) Leaf [28, 9, 16, 3, 11, 54, 12, 45]
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT root)
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT root)
let toListOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))
print (toListOf root)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k root) [28, 46, 20])

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
let shrink e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e
let exprs = [(Add (Add (Num 1) (Num (-2))) (Add (Num 1) (Mul (Num 9) (Num 0)))), (Mul (Neg (Neg (Num 5))) (Add (Mul (Num 9) (Num (-1))) (Neg (Num 2))))]
exprs |> List.map shrink |> List.map render |> List.iter print
print (List.map evalE exprs)

let powAcc b e acc =
  match e:
    case 0: acc
    case k if k % 2 == 1: powAcc b (k - 1) (acc * b)
    case k: powAcc (b * b) (k // 2) acc

let steps n acc =
  if n == 1 then acc
  else if n % 2 == 0 then steps (n // 2) (acc + 1)
  else steps (3 * n + 1) (acc + 1)

type Expr = Num int | Add Expr Expr | Mul Expr Expr | Neg Expr | Var string
let env = Map.ofList [("x", 6), ("y", -2)]
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 env
let render e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({render a} + {render b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{render a} * {render b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{render a}"
    case Var v: v
let exprs = [(Mul (Var "y") (Neg (Num (-2)))), (Mul (Add (Num 1) (Add (Num 1) (Num 2))) (Num 5)), (Add (Num 2) (Num 6))]

type Msg =
  | Turn int
  | Halt
  | Store int int
  | Skip int
let describe t =
  match t:
    case Turn n0 if n0 > 1: f"turn!({n0})"
    case Turn n0: f"turn({n0})"
    case Halt: f"halt"
    case Store n0 n1 if n0 % 2 == 0: f"store!({n0},{n1})"
    case Store n0 n1: f"store({n0},{n1})"
    case Skip n0 if n0 % 2 == 0: f"skip!({n0})"
    case Skip n0: f"skip({n0})"
let weight t =
  match t:
    case Halt: 6
    case Store x0 x1: x0 + x1 * 5
    case Skip x0: x0
    case _: 2
let batch = [Skip 6, Halt, Store 7 4, (Turn 9), Skip 1, (Store 2 0)]
print (batch |> List.map describe |> String.join "; ")
let total = batch |> List.sumBy weight
print f"total={total}"
print (List.maxBy weight batch)

let parseEntry line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    return (k, n)
  }

let combine xs =
  List.fold (fun acc r ->
    result {
      let! total = acc
      let! (_, n) = r
      return total + n
    }) (Ok 0) xs

let pipeline = List.sort >> (List.windowed 2 >> List.map (fun w -> Option.withDefault 0 (List.max w))) >> (List.map ((-) 41)) >> (List.takeWhile (fun x -> x < 44)) >> (List.drop 3) >> (List.chunkBySize 3 >> List.map List.sum)
let answer = readings |> pipeline |> List.sum
print answer
print <| List.len readings

type Line = { name: string, qty: int, price: float }
let rows = [Line { name = "pin", qty = 20, price = 21.18 }, Line { name = "tap", qty = 15, price = 0.22 }, Line { name = "hub", qty = 2, price = 24.18 }, Line { name = "wick", qty = 9, price = 8.6 }]
let showRow x = f"{Format.padRight 7 " " x.name}: {Format.padLeft 4 " " (String.fromInt x.qty)}: {Format.fixed 1 x.price}"
rows |> List.map showRow |> List.iter print
print f"{List.len rows} rows, {String.upper "total"}={Format.fixed 2 (List.fold (fun a x -> a + x.price) 0.0 rows)}"
